shortdesc.ph: Reasons for a user going offline.
Reasons for a user being offline.

plentry.pd: (0): The user voluntarily left the call.

(1): No data packet received within a certain time. SDK timeout, user dropped. If the user leaves the call but the message is not delivered to the SDK (due to an unreliable channel), the SDK considers the user dropped.
(2): The user switched their client role from host to audience.

pd.p: 1: The SDK times out and the user drops offline because no data packet is received within a certain period of time.
pd.note: If the user quits the call and the message is not passed to the SDK (due to an unreliable channel), the SDK assumes the user dropped offline.

plentry.pd: 2: The user switches the client role from the host to the audience.
